A '''[[Spider/Legends|spider]]-like creature''' inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dractu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The arachnid was quite large and possessed a [[Color/Legends|red]], elongated body which terminated in a head and tail. The tail was marked by two sharp [[Claw/Legends|claw]]-like organs, while the head exhibited six [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a jawless, tubular [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] with plentiful [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. The creature also possessed six long [[Limb/Legends|legs]], each composed of two segments, so tall that they could be mistaken for [[Tree/Legends|trees]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|cook]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] encountered the specimen while visiting Dractu. Jettster&mdash;who had arrived on the planet in pursuit of [[Dractuvian cave slug]]s&mdash;was escorted by a [[Unidentified Dractuvian warrior|tribal warrior]] familiar with local wildlife. After the pair entered a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] of dead [[Tree/Legends|trees]], Jettster leaned on the arachnid's limb, perceiving it to be deadwood. The tribesman directed Jettster's attention upwards, after which the two beheld the creature's maw above them. This provoked a short chase which ended with Jettster and the warrior concealing themselves behind a boulder.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Dractuvian_arachnid_rear.jpg|250px|thumb|A rear view of the arachnid]]
The creature was a massive being, [[Spider/Legends|arachnoid]] in both appearance and nature. The body was predominantly [[Color/Legends|red]] and presented an elongated [[exoskeleton]] composed of at least ten segments. The body curved upwards toward its rear and ended in a tail-like posterior marked by two hooked [[Claw/Legends|claw]]s or other such sharp protrusions. Its face defined the other end, exhibiting six [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] arranged vertically in two groups of three. Immediately below the eyes, continuous with the body, was a jawless [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], tubular in shape and encircled by rows of sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] affixed to both the interior and exterior of the mouth.<ref name="Appetite" />

For locomotion, the creature maintained six [[Limb/Legends|legs]] which protruded midway along its body. The legs were quite tall,<ref name="Appetite" /> lifting the arachnid to a height of over 4 meters,<ref name="height" /> and were composed of two segments each. The proximal segment was relatively short and smooth; the other was much longer and varied from from an uneven, rough texture to a smoother texture resembling the dead [[Tree/Legends|trees]] of its habitat.<ref name="Appetite" />

==Behavior==
The creature was a [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] predator which salivated at the sight of its next meal. Upon recognizing such as prey, the creature gave chase and emitted a loud screeching noise. However, the beast could be outmaneuvered by simply concealing oneself within one's surroundings. The arachnid was able to lure potential food sources by virtue of its camouflaged legs, which resembled the deadwood of the area it inhabited.<ref name="Appetite" />

==History==
[[File:Jettster-frightened.jpg|225px|thumb|left|The creature's mouth frightens Jettster.]]
Some time during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], at least one such arachnid lived near a cavernous region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dractu]]. At that time,<ref name="Appetite" /> a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]], [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> arrived on the planet in pursuit of [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Dractuvian cave slug]]s, which he planned to prepare for a patron, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. After the Besalisk gastronaut landed on Dractu in his [[Dexter Jettster's ship|small shuttle]], he commissioned a [[Unidentified Dractuvian warrior|local]] to assist him in navigating the perilous wildlife and locating the [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]].<ref name="Appetite" />

Jettster and his native escort embarked on their journey and soon discovered an area studded by dead and withered trees. Unbeknownst to Jettster, the great hexapod had also settled over the dead [[Forest/Legends|forest]], its upright legs appearing to the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] chef to be tree trunks themselves. He absent-mindedly leaned upon the beast's limbs, rousing the creature, and then looked upward at his guide's suggestion, only to find the toothed maw of the arachnid salivating over him. Frightened, Jettster and the native fled the scene, the crimson creature screeching in pursuit. After some time, the pair hid behind a rock and lost the animal. With the native's assistance, Jettster was eventually able to retrieve the relevant [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropod]]s, which he then prepared at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], only to find that Kenobi was disgusted by the dish.<ref name="Appetite" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dractuvian arachnid appears in ''[[Appetite for Adventure]]'', a story from ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9]]'', the ninth volume of the titular graphic novel series. The story was written by the [[Fillbach Brothers]], lettered by [[Michael Heisler]], and illustrated by [[Ronda Pattison]]. It was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[October 23]], [[2007]].<ref name="Appetite" /><ref name="darkhorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-623/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-9|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 9}}</ref>
